startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to start crawling from, e.g. a company website. Only same-origin links are followed.

maxDepth.title: Crawl Depth
maxDepth.description: Maximum crawl depth from the start URLs (currently the crawler extracts emails from start URLs and links one level deep).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential proxies are recommended for sites with anti-bot protection.
